measurement_note: Size is the number n of joined driver/vehicle/trip records aggregated and partition-ranked across three fuel types.

generator.source:
n = 24
fuels = ['Diesel', 'Electric', 'Gasoline']
drivers = [{'driver_id': i, 'name': f'D{i}', 'age': 30, 'experience': 5, 'accidents': i % 4} for i in range(1, n + 1)]
vehicles = [{'vehicle_id': i, 'driver_id': i, 'model': 'M', 'fuel_type': fuels[(i - 1) % 3], 'mileage': i} for i in range(1, n + 1)]
trips = [{'trip_id': i, 'vehicle_id': i, 'distance': 1000 if i <= 3 else i, 'duration': 10, 'rating': 5 if i <= 3 else 4} for i in range(1, n + 1)]
case = {'tables': {'Drivers': drivers, 'Vehicles': vehicles, 'Trips': trips}}
expected = {'columns': ['fuel_type', 'driver_id', 'rating', 'distance'], 'rows': [['Diesel', 1, 5.0, 1000], ['Electric', 2, 5.0, 1000], ['Gasoline', 3, 5.0, 1000]]}
